relevant_laws.notes: Public highway dedication, boundaries and full width, erected official device authority, conformity and extent, and parking purpose require reviewed originals. No numeric legal narrowness cutoff is inferred.
relevant_laws.quote: When official traffic-control devices are erected prohibiting parking upon a narrow highway, a person shall not park a vehicle upon any such highway.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: source-reviewed motor vehicle parking on a narrow highway with official prohibitory device
